verdict.rationale: Bring Your Own Machine lets you register a VPS, workstation, or on-prem server running Linux, macOS, or Windows as a Droid Computer. The Droid CLI, headless `droid exec` (for CI/CD and scripts) and the SDK run the same agent harness locally or from your own code, which covers the local and own-VM parts of the story. Missing for 10: explicit container or Docker deployment documentation, evidence of a fully self-hosted control plane (BYOM machines appear to register with Factory's platform), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
